items.description: A Cross-platform app built using Appcelerator and the OTNet.tv media API.
Maps channel program information to relevant Twitter account

Flixster provides services for discovering, collecting, and watching movies and TV programs. Users can create a profile and store movie ratings, favorites, lists, and more. Users can connect their profile with friends, and discover, purchase and view a variety of content. The services offered from Flixster can be integrated with social media platforms and other applications.
A BBC News Data visualization demo using PHP + HTML5 + CSS3 + jQuery.
Ministry Ops is a simple hosted platform for churches and ministries to publish & share audio and video files. Just upload your video and it's converted, and distributed

LOCPix allows searching and viewing of the digitized photo collections from the Library of Congress. Browse collections or search the vast archive for interesting historical photographs and poster artwork. Hundreds of thousands of images are available, many in high resolution.

A selection of independently developed add-in buttons that make Thrutu on Android even more useful. The following buttons are currently available. There are plenty more planned... - Barcode reader - Recommend installed application - Browse to My WebPage - Share browser bookmark - Share BBC News article **NEW** Although the Button Collection is currently only available on Android, most buttons can happily be used when in a Thrutu call with someone using the iPhone version of Thrutu. - Barcode reader - Recommend installed application - Browse to My WebPage - Share browser bookmark - Share BBC News article

Subscribe to your Delicious TV feed and program your Boxe TV from delicous. Bookmark videos, genre listings, playlists, other peoples Delicious TV listings, etc. to delicious, then view them in Boxee.

An Atlas using Google maps. Upon querying a country, the map locates the country, it provides a list of useful links to learn about the country in question, and a aggregation of news from major RSS providers, filtered by country in Yahoo pipes.
Route Scanner automatically works out relevant traffic incidents which could affect your journey and displays them on an interactive map. It uses RSS feeds from the BBC and Highways Agency. UK Only.
IbizaA-Z.com and Ibiza Now Magazine. Everything from one Google Map.
Share your cycling, walking, hiking, and paddling routes with the world. See maps, photos, and stats about each route, or create your own.

This Netvibes module searches for audio, video, photo or document files from your Orb account matching a search string. Clicking on results can play corresponding video or audio stream, open picture in a new window or download the document.
Explore UK radio and television. Extensive search options. Uses data from BBC Backstage. Data available in multiple formats: RSS, iCal, JSON.
Takes a BBC Programme search and converts the results in to iCal format for use in Google Calendar.
Travel advisories in the UK on a Google Map (with BBC Backstage data).
Lets you find premiership soccer news by team location. Via Google Maps and BBC Backstage data.
Mashup of Google Maps with the most recent venture capital deals and startups in Silicon Valley.

MAPlight.org launched the Influence Tracker widget to provide voters with financial information that influences political candidates. For example, by entering a senators name Influence Tracker will output capital contributions that might have swayed that senators vote.
Adictive photo puzzle game. Match two pictures that have something in common in the picture. Your goal is to match the photos that have these tags in common. Harder than it seems.
Searches the iPhone/iPad App Store using the iTunes API. Provides instant search feedback with top apps, including their large icons. Created by people behind App of the Day site.
GeoTag Flickr-Photos via GPS track file. Start tracking-mode on your gps-device, go on a phototour, share your photos by flickr and Geotag them.
Webcams around the world with Google Maps.
A well-organized way to play music videos.
Lets you instantly search the Italian Play.me music catalogue. Preview a track and if you are a subscriber, listen and download it on www.playme.it.
A Twilio clone of the Dial-A-Joke system. The joke with the most votes is considered the featured joke and is played when you call the application's phone number.
A Google Gadget that polls top songs and album feeds from Rhapsody RSS to let users stay on top of news about their favorite artists.

Corobot checks tasks from your cohuman (www.cohuman.com) workspace and does them for you - and let's you and your team know when each task is complete. Corobot is available in two products: Corobot Companion is an intelligent automaton who lives within Cohuman (cohuman.com). He's there to help 24/7 with any cohuman-based project - just invite him in and put him to work! Coming in April 2011 will be the Corobot Task Appliance - which is a dedicated environment to turn your choice of cohuman user into a task-completer with full flexibility to customize and program to complete any task of your choosing.
This tool shows the real-time position of Princess Cruises ships. Many ships feature a live webcam stream.
spoonacular is a semantic recipe search engine.

Citizens have access to planning petitions currently under review in the City of Ann Arbor via mashups that track statuses of site plans, zoning, area plans, annexations, land divisions, and special exception uses.
Enthusem is a service that allows users to send physical greeting cards online. Through its integration with Box.net, users can send cards containing content from their Box.net files.
Social Butterfly allows you to anonymously chat with random strangers through Google Talk. If you use Gmail, you already have Google Talk.
BuzzData lets you share your data in a smarter, easier way. Instead of juggling versions and overwriting files, use BuzzData and enjoy a social network designed for data.
A guide to Bed and Breakfasts that makes extensive use of Google Maps.

Music video playlists, playing popular pop, rock, hiphop, and dance, with newest music video releases. 26+ hours of uninterrupted and continuously playing music videos. Use it for parties. Integrated YouTube videos.

Example application and source code showing how to use the Nintendo Wii to control 3D Virtual Earth maps. Take the Virtual Earth control out of the web browser, use it in a WinForms application, and control it with a Nintendo Wii Remote.
Collaborative mapping for virtual tourists.
Google Maps mashup of the Detroit Tigers players and where they are from. Popups include photos and links to detailed stats.
Mashup satellite images from BBC Weather and t7online. See the Instructions tab to see how to do it.
Shows a random Google Street View, with the ability to choose by continent or country. There's also a beta feature to restrict rural roadways.

ActionSprout is a web application that can be integrated into Facebook. ActionSprout enables Facebook users to share events and/or sign petitions right on their Facebook page. ActionSprout enables its customers to connect with and find support from others through Facebook directly.
Instantly call everyone in your team using group call and toll-free conference calls for team leaders. Call at any time with no need to schedule, or hold scheduled calls with up to 20 participants.
Find Twitter users near your location and bulk follow them. With LocaFollow you can search by keywords in the Bio and Location fields.
Overlays historical aerial photographs of Detroit over current imagery to demonstrate change over time. The site features aerial imagery from 1949, 52, 56, 61, 76, 81, 97, 2005 and 06.
Soccer National league tables in a map, plus soccer news. You can search based on teams and leagues.

Penger.io is a web portal where the user can compare credit cards and loans from the Norwegian market. The site is pulling data from Finansportalen's API, which is then mashed together to create: Aggregated comparison pages for different types of loans and credit cards. Individual loan/credit card listing pages with all the available information on a specific product. Business information such as legal name, contact phone, website and address for the banks
Foamee helps track who you owe beers or coffees to, and vice versa.

FlowTest allows you to test OpenVBX Call Flows - as well as the text-to-speech engine - using the new OpenVBX Browser Phone. Instead of dialing in multiple times as you tweak your flows, you can can now test without even using your phone. When you start testing, the OpenVBX Browser Phone will ring, but once it's answered, you can continue to test different flows or the text-to-speech engine while the call is ongoing.
An online social game that covertly teaches students how to do library research while they go about the business of completing a research-and-writing assignment.
Show off your Foursquare badges and mayorships on Facebook, your Blog, or your Website.
Simple use of the API, integrated with vBulletin software.
SAP FICO Jobs is a job board for consultants and analysts of SAP Finance and Controlling modules.
Allows Twitter users to host and manage a group conference call with a few simple clicks.
Local news for Northumberland County, Ontario, Canada. Integrates local news sources with Flickr and Twitter activity in the area.
Selection of the most funny and interesting YouTube video clips.
Korean mashup with Naver maps and Google satellite photos.
This mashup (hosted in an iframe under CafePress.com itself) was created entirely using the Instagram and CafePress apis. No access to the internals of CafePress needed.

Enterprise Rideshare specializes in providing customized vanpool programs and commuter services for individuals and companies across the country. Enterprise Rideshare, a Division of Enterprise Rent-A-Car, was founded in 1994 and has become a national leader in servicing both individual vanpool groups and large employer work sites. The enterpriserideshare.com is a online platform for the Rideshare program. enterpriserideshare.com provides the unified view of the rideshare offering from Enterprise. enterpriserideshare.com enables to customer to search and apply for a vanpool from any given location within the US. enterpriserideshare.com also offers the seamless ability to signup and complete the agreement formalities via an online process.
Dirt-simple in-browser conference calls. Start a call, invite others, and begin talking.
Google Maps + Twitter view of Unemployed in America. Tweets split into Eastern/Western United States.
Ramazon uses the Flare Visualization Toolkit to create an interactive visualization of related items on Amazon.com.
Shop home furnishing items across 2 million products and 20 stores. Uses APIs from Commission Junction and Shopping.com.
A Minecraft mod that adds tracking of carbon emissions using AMEE.
Convert url to full size image or thumbnail in batch. Capture webpages/websites screenshot from their URLs in batch. Make images of web pages (convert web pages to images) in batch.

One Click Politics is an advocacy platform that allows campaign supporters to send messages to certain individuals. With One Click Politics, supporters are able to reach out to influential figures in the political arena that surround the candidates.
Uses Google Maps & Places API to make viewing nearby search results easy.
Create an instant mosaic from your Twitter or LiveJournal friends pictures. You can print it on a mug, a T-shirt, a mousepad or a bag.
Zoomf is a UK property search engine listing properties on a simple and intuitive Google Maps interface.
Uses the InterFAX SendfaxEx method to send a binary file such as Microsoft Word or Acrobat PDF to any fax number.
Maps the speeches, messages of support and upcoming meetings, from www.flocktogether.org.uk, of Ming Campbell MP, candidate to lead the UK Liberal Democrats.
German movie portal. Uses APIs from YouTube, Google Maps and Amazon.
Indeed job search integrated with Facebook and LinkedIn - find jobs close to friends, and see who you know (or contacts know) at those offering the job.
Maps popular Vancouver British Columbia attractions with links to more information.
Mobile lead distribution service for our broker partners.
TwitAku.com provides a Twitter service: Twitter Signatures which generates an image with user's latest Tweet message, follower and friends status
Database of over 11,000 airfields and airports across the world, from major internationals like New York, Paris and London to more out-of the way airstrips like Antartica.

CanyonRunner is a 2D side-scroller HTML5 game that works on desktop and mobile, features a story and all the basic game systems you'd expect such as a progress saving system, top scores, different game dynamics on each level and two different endings. This application uses Ludei Cloud API.
A map of all of the economic protests in Myanmar, aka Burma.
Tidely is an ocean tide table application built on the NOAA CO-OPS Tide Prediction API. It allows you to quickly find your local tides by entering your zip code.
Virtual skydive using Google Maps.
Togfrog is videos with maps covering a wide selection of adventure travel activities that can inspire and guide travelers going on adventures all over the world.
Worldwide dive site atlas and reference. Hundreds of dive sites from all continents listed. Sites mapped on Google Maps.

VideoTag is a one-player tagging game. Tag some of the funniest YouTube videos, avoid the pitfalls and progress to the next level. See if you can make the top of the leaderboard and become the ultimate video tagger.
Utility to perform a ICMP Ping from 30+ location worldwide.
Allows you to create mosaics of photos from Flickr. Each mosaic is one large image composed of small tile images.
Using carpark information and map information from OneMotoring.com.sg and Google Maps respectively, users can have a birds-eye view of all the parking costs in Singapore.
See Amazon.com customer reviews and editorials within the online card catalog of the Boulder, Colo., public library.
A Google Maps interface to a database of thousands of hang gliding and paragliding sites around the world, with a feed to show the same in Google Earth.
Real-time group communications over SMS, web browser, and smartphone applications. Formerly called group.ly
Real-time schedules and rider alerts from Metro Transit on iPhone, Android, and Windows Mobile devices
Most popular trends on Twitter aggregator.

For each of the 1.95 million DBpedia concepts, the wrappr generates a collection of flickr photos that depict the concept, utilizing multilingual labels and geo-coordinates provided in Wikipedia entries.
See the most talked about videos...currently tracking YouTube, MySpace and Google Video.
Real estate mashup of luxury homes and condominiums on the Monterey Peninsula, California. It shows properties listed at $2.9 million and higher. It is updated daily with new listings.
Tour the locations of the Da Vinci Code on this Google Map. Includes locations and routes in France, UK, and Italy.

Web widgets that display Amazon items and earn referral revenue through Amazon Associates. Browser is an Amazon mini browser. List displays wish lists, baby and wedding registries, List Mania lists. Latest and Greatest shows bestsellers and new releases.
Watch new photos being uploaded to Flickr in real time. Uses Ajax.
Search for and get maps and directions to businesses in your area.
Interactive map of current and past members of the Iraq Multinational Coalition, current troop count by country, and related links.
Amazon shopping meets YouTube to bring product trailers and videos mashed up with Amazon product content.

A guide for Red Sox fans visiting Ft Myers, Florida for spring training. Created with the Atlas mapping tool. Fans can plot photos on a satellite image of City of Palms Park and comment on businesses found via Google Local Search.

San Diego School Pal is the easiest way to see San Diego's school districts and their associated levels of crime. We combine a school district map with the 2011 San Diego crime database and Megan's Law statistics. Browse across a map view of San Diego, combined with overlay regions for each of the school districts, covering elementary, high school, and unified. Enter your address to search and locate your own school district or browse the list to get statistics across the city. Share your opinion and thoughts about any San Diego school district with the built-in commenting system, and help others find the best one for their needs.
Lists the most popular bookmarks in del.icio.us over specific time periods, such as 4 hours, a day, a week, a month and a year.
Shop for a variety of gifts. Uses the Amazon eCommerce API.
Wide collection of Arabic media including TV, radio, movies and clips.

No-refresh has launched the online Shopify T-shirt designer software with a whole lot of groundbreaking features. Apart from seamless integration with Shopify shopping cart, the tool lets the end-users of an online fashion portal to create customized design on a range of apparels including t-shirts, sweatshirts, hoodies, jerseys, and others. The software boasts a rich yet simple user interface with an impressive set of the image library. It is essentially a SAAS-based tool that can be availed without any obligation of a license for the lifetime.
Voxora is an easy way to share voice messages from places you visit. Check in on foursquare then call voxora and leave a message, call and listen to messages left by everyone else.
A map mashup which shows locations of 32 participating countries along with Team News (via Google News) and Team Blogs (via WorldCupBlog.org)
Good mashup that plots fun and entertaining quotes from Overheard in New York on a Google Map.

Glancely lets you search Etsy at a glance. Start typing and your search results appear instantly below. Hover over an image to get a closer look. Click to see the item on Etsy and buy it. Looking for something in a particular color? Just click one of the color icons to filter by that color. You can sort by price also.
Local Weather is a web application that automatically show users their local weather forecast. This application uses ipinfo.io API and OpenWeatherMap API.
Mashup of www.senate.gov and Google Maps displays all the current United States Senators with their office address, phone number, contact information and website.

Elseif is the hangout place for developers, programmers and hackers. Come and watch the curated set of screencasts and explore and discover the wonderful world of repositories. Contents are curated in a way that is easy to find.
Simple surveys to share with friends through Twitter, sms or email. Anywhere you can paste text, you can give a wedgie (a simple survey).
This GMail gadget displays real-time arrival estimates of the Madison Metro at a specified stop.
TutorLinker is a tool which helps you find a tutor in your area for your tutoring needs.
Find the people making great handmade things
A continuous stream of videos from YouTube by (or related to) the rock band, The Decemberists.
To accurately and completely map the progress of Jack Aubrey, Stephen Maturin and their ships over the course of the 21 novels by Patrick OBrian.
Google Maps mashup solving a transit problem: how to reach from one point to another in Moscow. This mashup can trace routes of Moscow city transport and display them on a map and in special view.

Drawloop lets you merge and automate document creation. The service increases sales efficiency, improve close rates and increase revenue by allowing sales reps to create dynamic document packages or DDPs (bundle of Excel, Word, PowerPoint and PDF files).
List and Map of activities and events near to Aviemore, Cairngorms National Park. Live product data pulled via the TourCMS Marketplace API and plotted on a Map via the Google Maps API.
Discover all the artists playing at thse 2013 Austin City Limits Music Festival taking place on October 4-6 & 11-13 in Austin, TX with ACL.fm, the unofficial radio app for ACL Fest.
Find your Land-Kitespot and other Kiters. Ability to draw Kitespots and upload images.
TheFoundBin.com is the largest online collection of free, map-based lost and found listings. The site allows owners and finders of pets and valuables to post lost and found items for free.
A service for rating tweets and twitters.
Australian Federal Election Demographics Analysis Tool
One Stop Cottage, the Holiday Cottage Search Engine, is a very fast way to find your UK holiday cottage. It quickly searches over 40,000 cottages from 35 companies.

An instant messenger bot to search for full forms of abbreviations. If you type ROFL in your GTalk/Jabber window you get all the possible full forms of the abbreviation. The service uses Abbreviations.com API and is meant for non commercial use only.
A retail experience combining the API networks of Amazon, Twitter and YouTube with a plan to expand into further APIs to add increased syndication of data and media.
Free HTML5 slideshows from Facebook, Flickr, Photobucket, Smugmug, Picasa, Youtube (as soundtrack music) and SlideshowBox HTML5 slideshow component.
The top 25 American cities with population greater than 250,000 ranked by percentage of bachelor degree holders among residents 25 years and older.
Shows the NYC subway system on a Google Map.
FoxyMap is a Google Gadget which allows you to monitor the locations of speed traps. Those locations are set via mobile tagging by the users of the mobile application FoxyTag.
Voice-enabled language translator for mobile devices. It allows two-way real-time communication between two people who cannot speak a common language
Start a mailrace on a Google map.
An efficient Captcha Bypass Service.

Click4Support provides a broad array of services for its customers from PC repair for virus removal in Essex, CT, US with customers in the United States, the United Kingdom, Australia and Canada. Click4Support uses the SupportFu API.

Mobypicture enables you to add postings with pictures to Twitter and also get these directly posted to your Flickr-album. You can use it from your mail client or directly from your phone, so you can show your friends what your doing instead of typing it.
Gender Analyzer figures out if a text is written by a male or female using artificial intelligence.
Online tool to create non linear narratives. Integrates the YouTube API.

This product is about providing opinion about your friends, about different topics, or practically anything on the web. All our friends have different characteristics, and we either like it or don't. However very few of us let our friends know what we like or dislike about them.

Tries to simulate the simple joys of talking over CB radio on the highway. Just call in and enter the number of a highway and you will be entered into a group chat with other people traveling along the same road.

Downloads entries from the Flickr public photos Atom feed every 2 hours and caches them in Amazon DynamoDB (zaps atoms into Dynamo). Why? So you can do zappy fast searches and likes of photos using DynamoDB, the premier fully managed NoSQL database service on the cloud today.
Map of March 2008 protests in Tibet, and ensuing events. With photos, summaries, and links to supporting documentation about the Tibetan Centre for Human Rights and Democracy, TCHRD, website.
ShoutNow makes sharing your voice through Twitter, Facebook and phones simple and easy. Instantly share voice messages with your friends, family, teams, employees or customers.
Find the best airports for wifi. Based on a Forbes survey of the most wired airports, mapped on Google Maps.
Geomium is a local social application that allows you to meet people near you and see what's going on around you. Geomium. Live local. Live social.
It's a non-commercial city portal with a Google Mgap of Torun, a beatiful, medieval Polish town.
loc.alize.us displays a massive amount of photos on a highly interactive world map. Explore photos from everyones places, selected topics or people you know.

See where your ocean container shipment is via real-time maps on SeaRates. Helps freight forwarders and logistics companies to perform global shipping operations with international container shipments.
Twoogle is a twitter search that allows you to search Twitter by geo location instant live search, ipad iphone android. Also build a Twitter collage from a choosen key word, have fun and share.

Send and receive faxes directly to and from a Google Docs account with InterFAX. Send faxes by simply clicking a bookmarklet; receive faxes directly into your Google Docs folder. Logging on to the InterFAX control panel is not even necessary.
Maps and descriptions of skateparks for skateboarding and biking in europe. User contributed content.

Athenaeum is a mashup of Goodreads.com and Toronto Public Library created by Chris Nolan. Goodreads API allows to personalize book preferences, reason why the mashup can be found useful by members of the Toronto Public Library. Contents include how to use, tests, and known issues. Just like the author, users can automatically take checked out items and add them to Goodreads.com shelves.
Free online rental market facts and analysis service dedicated to helping renters and investors make better rental and investment decisions.
Watch the internet as it's being uploaded. Every 10 seconds it grabs the newest public photo from Flickr.
Create map riddles for your friends and the world.
Job Search Website for passive job seekers. This service lets you list your ideal job and have recruiters do all the work for you.
Provides small businesses an interface to enter polling questions, possible answers and tabulates the responses to provide valuable information to the merchant. Formerly called Voicify.
Find your dining places in Croatia: restaurants, tTaverns, pizzerias, and other spots
A stylish mashup that helps you find information on gas prices, movies, restaurants, traffic, local events, WiFi locations, driving directions, and more on a Virtual Earth map.
List of the most endangered destinations in the world, with the threats they are facing.

e-TXT Solutions is a web-based system that uses a process which combines text, mobile payments, gift, and loyalty cards into one integrated system. This system allows non-profits and political organizations to advertise/promote their campaigns/causes to raise money on a global scale.
Shows you where 1661 hot springs are in the US through NOAA data + Google Maps.

Mapinterest links Pinterest, Instagram and YouTube with Facebook Places. You follow people on Twitter, on Facebook you follow your friends, on Pinterest you follow topics and on Mapinterest you follow places.
There are literally thousands of hotels across the world employing green policies of some kind, but these hotels truly represent the best of green culture.
Video classifieds site that connects the local community and assists sellers and buyers in making transactions via videos.
This mashup uses Google Maps to display wineries around Pennsylvania. Users can navigate the map to learn more about potential destinations.
Listpic finds posts to Oodle that contain pictures and allows one to easily browse through the posts by theses pictures. This uses data from eBay, Craigslist and Etsy. Formerly called listpic.
Recent school shootings mapped. Compiled from infoplease.com

Twitter Mobile Monitor uses a Jquery interface to search tweet by keywords, including hashtags, on cross platform smart device (IPhone tested). It's a simple web app alternative to data apps and a useful to keep away from data collecting. The interface automatically scrolls tweets and updates the query every 120 seconds.
Wikinear.com shows Wikipedia pages near you, based on your location according to Yahoo! Fire Eagle. The site is optimized for use on a mobile phone.

If you ever had problems ordering camera supplies from a vendor in NYC, then this map might be of interest. It plots the locations, along with photos and comments, of dozens of vendors. Not always reputable ones.
Real-time HTML/CSS/Javascript editor and advanced Search Engine dedicated to web development and design.
A photo puzzle game that integrates photos from Flickr. This game was built using the sharendipity platform.

Create custom t-shirts and other apparels with your unique message encoded as QR codes. People can scan your back with the QR applications on their smartphone and decode your custom message, link to websites, videos and pictures
Join us as we explore some of the most awe inspiring events on Planet Earth: great animal migrations. We are asking you to contribute to the project wherever it happens.
With this App you can synchronize your Google Contacts to be part of you network on Tradeshift

Display your Google Latitude location and location history. Guest and public access options control who can view your location. Dead Zone keeps your location from being displayed when you are within X miles of the location you specify.
A Mac OS X desktop application that lets you browse your del.icio.us accounts.
Weather forecasts for South Africa.
See George W's life history plotted on this Google Map.

The Mars Explorer app (for Android devices) allows you to explore The Red Planet as a whole or through the eyes of one of three NASA rovers currently on the surface. Learn about each of the three rovers and the data they collect on the surface of Mars. Search through years worth of pictures the rovers have taken. Save and share your favorite pictures. Learn about how the rovers work and how they were built. Learn something new about Mars every day with the Daily Fact home screen widget. Get the latest weather details from the Rover Environmental Monitoring Station on board the Curiosity Rover.

A better search for Flickr. Uses special processing to find for more than just what you search for. Searching for music will not just look for that word but also for concert, band, ipod and other related concepts.

SnapsBoard help to preserve photos and videos in the original resolution. The mashup's principle: never lose a photo, is related to privacy, personalization, and categorization found in the app. While organizing digital images could be important for some members, others prefer to print images from a smart phone. That's why SnapsBoard offers a Walgreen's printing service connected to the phone.
Image search in the 2 million royalty free images in photo bank Fotolia. Also use it to create instant e-cards.
See where your friends are located in the UK. Click on the markers to see their details in the information window.
Topix includes deals and daily deals on their map portion of their page. All deals sourced by 8coupons.
A useful, single-page application to create calendar posters. Customize the layout of the poster, add holiday calendars, import any public Google calendar. Download as image or PDF.
MyMemory Language Translator is an application that lets users to translate text from one language to another. This application uses the MyMemory API service.
Great collection of road biking rides in and around Salt Lake City, UT.
Google Map Mashup of Gaza Strip attack by Israel. Shows Day by Day events in Gaza and Israel and casualties of Palestinians and Israelis. Data Source from The Guardian News.

Visual Traceroute is a web application that enables users to trace the path packets take through the Internet, by entering the URL. This application uses ipinfo.io API for geolocation and ISP details.
Indian entertainment site. Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu videos. TV shows, music, interviews and more. Categorized videos based on different tags.
This tool uses the Google Maps API to display the fastest route with multiple stops between destinations.
Lunchflock is a niche service aimed at shepherding lunch-goers into flocks large enough to earn them group discounts at their favorite restaurants. Twilio delivers the discounts to users via sms.
A virtual war memorial for Australian service men and women buried around the world.
This is a demo bookstore that uses the Amazon Product Advertisement API. It provides books in a well-categorized manner.

This website uses Virtual Earth mapping technologies and real-time GPS location data to display the current locations of all ferryboats in the fleet. Click on the thumbnail map of a specific route to view a larger map with current ship status.
Built on the MotorsportReg.com API, this jQuery mobile app lets organizers list attendees and check people in on-site plus more.

BeeLiked, is a new social media marketing tool built specifically to help you maximise engagement with BeeLiked campaign features, and then manage and promote your contest with our social dashboard. The platform enables you to launch a Twitter contest within minutes, manage and moderate entries with minimal hassle, and then pick winners ethically and quickly.
UK Local Knowledge - Using data from the directory enquiries database plotted onto a Google Map.
The Twitter streaming API is used to deliver real-time stock tips from the highest ranked Twitter stock market experts. Get the details on today's most tweeted stocks, tags, and URLs.
Lets people reprint public domain books from Internet Archive and Google Books.
This Google Maps Mashup animates thru latest tweets tagged with #egypt (related to Egypt Protests)
Map of Las Vegas hotels, including all the main hotels on the Strip.
A service that allows you to give floral gifts without having to know the recipient's address.

Dunkathon is a HotOrNot version of basketball dunking clips. Videos are retrieved by filtering clips from YouTube API and only keep the ones that are relevant to dunking and short in length, 40 sec or less.
Use this interactive map to find Boots Optician stores in the UK.
ListnPlay allows users to make and share playlists of audio, video, albums or other people's playlists.
Foodio54 has an editable database of over a half million restaurants that users can rate and review. The site uses collaborative filtering to make restaurant recommendations.
Manage, monitor, and control your (mt) Media Temple services on your Android device. More details at droiddevil.com

Calculate your geoposition by address and create geotags, geo-metatags and kml files for your website, weblog or photo. Use a drag-and-drop marker on the result map to optimize your position. NEW: Reverse lookup - Enter a geocoded URL, see its location.
A visualization of events. Bubbles featuring the most popular art and design events in New York City. Built using the Art Beat API.
Visitors can use the Street View camera to take a holiday picture. Users can take as many pictures as they like and then submit them for a chance to win a holiday in Majorca.
Yet another web2.0 travel application that helps you find the holiday rentals. Most are located in France and Italy.
Takes data submitted with a Formstack form and creates corresponding event entries on a Google Calendar.
This mashup will enable NGOs to better utilise SMS for social activism and public accountability. Sends SMS using the Nexmo hosted SMS service.
Pronunciations Android app based on Forvo API

Worldsaurus.com is a worldwide travel guide to help adventurous budget-travelers, backpackers, photographers, and vacationers plan their trips. Find the most popular places in the world, with detailed information.
Google map mashup of the services that are open 24-hours in major US cities. Currently covers Seattle, Los Angeles, and New York City. Currently over 2400 locations.
Monitors Rhapsody for tracks played and automatically submits them to a users Last.fm profile.
Mashup that uses the new Flickr API video features to let you browse the newest videos on Flickr.
Virtual Earth tour of New York City using Google Earth and Mapfish.

Hab.la is a FREE service for chatting with visitors to your website using any jabber compatible IM client: iChat, adium, Meebo, Pidgin. Google Translate translates the conversations into the language of your choice, in real-time.

Supermetrics Data Grabber fetches your Google Analytics, AdWords, Bing Ads, Facebook & YouTube data to MS Excel on Windows and Mac. Eliminate time-consuming manual data fetching, processing and visualization work. Designed especially for people working with lots of sites / PPC campaigns / Facebook pages, to make it easier to get all the data in one place.

The Gifanator employs the Giphy API along with the Twilio API to allow people to receive or send randomly generated Gifs via text messaging. Users can also select keywords from a list of negative and positive emotions to send more specific Gifs to their friends.

TalkRain “Social Call” helps users to call, capture and share. User can call their friend, at the end of the call they will presented with a shorten URL of the recording to share over their Social Network. TalkRain “Conference” helps users to call, capture and Upload. Welly is a mobile application that provides users their very own companion creature that travels with them and tracks their steps with the Fitbit activity monitor. It is an interactive activity game that makes workout simple and fun.

Scholarley is the unofficial Android client for viewing and managing Mendeley documents from an Android device. Mendeley users can open documents and attachments, and sort documents by artist, folder, group, author, and tags. Due to limitations on the Mendeley API, annotations are not supported in Scholarley.

MSpider.net aims to help many different types of music lovers to explore music; one user can explore music of different regions or types, another might be curious to hear music related to an artist that he/she enjoys and another may want to generate a jukebox to play background music at the office. Because the music is located on youTube this creates an opportunity to find a wide range of results (interviews, live events, singles etc.). Users create stations to store their compilations and can share stations with their 'friends' by posting links on their facebook timeline.
